Before: two fried eggs (likely cooked without much fat, ~ 92 g total, ~ 140 kcal), two slices of toast (~ 50 g, ~ 130 kcal), two butter portions (~ 7 g each, ~ 50 kcal total), and tea (negligible).

After: the plate is almost clean, with only crumbs left. The butter containers are empty-looking, though they sit on the plate, so the butter was probably used. The tea was probably drunk, but it adds no calories.

Eggs: two fried eggs at about 46 g each is about 92 g, ~ 150 kcal with some oil.
Toast: two slices, ~ 25 g each, so 50 g, ~ 135 kcal.
Butter: 2 × 7 g = 14 g, ~ 100 kcal if 7 g each (butter is ~ 7 kcal/g). But the portions may be 10 g each, and they are shown as used. I'll use 2 × 7 g = 14 g, ~ 100 kcal.

Total: 150 + 135 + 100 = 385 kcal, and 92 + 50 + 14 = 156 g. I'll leave out the tea.
